description: A question about another passage (Melchizedek, while on Romans 8:28): the answer says what that passage says, names a verse about him by book, chapter and verse (Genesis 14:18-20, Psalm 110:4, Hebrews 5:6, 5:10, 6:20 or 7:1-17: any one of them, the example does not pick which), and does not send him away to ask elsewhere; with no study resource on the app draws no link whatever `links` holds (tests/unit/links-grind.test.ts and features/tutor-links.feature), so this example does not demand that `links` is empty.

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: Who is Melchizedek?
